resolved.title: 箱形图 Box Plot
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Box Plot[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A box plot is used to visualize the distribution of values in a column, basically visualizing the result of the [b]describe[/b]() function. 

For example, let's create a box plot for the cases in June:[code format="py" codeId="3246"]df[df["month"]==6]["cases"].plot(kind="box") [/code][img id="4563" width="100%"]The green line shows the [b]median[/b] value.
The box shows the upper and lower quartiles (25% of the data is greater or less than these values).
The circles show the [b]outliers[/b], while the black lines show the min/max values excluding the outliers.
[note]Check out the following article for more information on box plots: [a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_plot"][b]Box plots[/b][/a][/note]

箱形图用于可视化一列中数值的分布，基本上是将描述()函数的结果可视化。

例如，让我们为6月份的案例创建一个箱形图。

content.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")
df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df.set_index('date', inplace=True)

df[df["month"]==6]["cases"].plot(kind="box")
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

content.text:
绿线表示**中位数median**值。
框内显示上四分位数和下四分位数（25%的数据大于或小于这些值）。
圆圈表示**离群值**，而黑线表示不包括离群值的最小/最大值。
content.text_html:
The green line shows the median value. The box shows the upper and lower quartiles (25% of the data is greater or less than these values). The circles show the outliers, while the black lines show the min/max values excluding the outliers.

resolved.title: 直方图 Histogram
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Histogram[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Similar to box plots, [b]histograms[/b] show the distribution of data.
Visually histograms are similar to bar charts, however, histograms display frequencies for a group of data rather than an individual data point; therefore, no spaces are present between the bars. 

Typically, a histogram groups data into chunks (or bins).

[b]For example:[/b][code format="py" ]df[df["month"]==6]["cases"].plot(kind="hist") [/code][img id="4564" width="100%"] The histogram grouped the data into 9 bins and shows their frequency. You can see that, for example, only single data points are greater than 6000.
[note]You can manually specify the number of bins to use using the [b]bins[/b] attribute: [b]plot(kind="hist", bins = 10)[/b][/note]

直方图在视觉上类似于条形图(Bar Chart)，但是，直方图显示的是一组数据的频率，而不是单个数据点；因此，条形图之间没有空格。
